description:
Activate Tree of Tales by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Tree of Tales to become a creature until end of turn.
Tree of Tales dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Salvaging Station, untapping Salvaging Station.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Tree of Tales from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
